thread:
rachel: quick RFC follow-up: we need a single, auditable flow for billing tags across ingest->enrich->query. current ad-hoc patches in qstores are getting expensive.
devin: agreed. option A: authoritative at ingest (fast), B: enrichers may override, C: reconciler sets final after joins. each has cost vs correctness tradeoffs.
oming: data point from sampling: ~3.9% of envelopes get a billing_key added/changed in late enrichment; they represent ~8% of token cost. not huge volume, big $$$.
lee: proposal: keep a tiny ingest_hint on envelope.top (billing_hint), enrichers write enriched_key + confidence, daily reconciler writes final_billing_key + provenance. UI surfaces live vs final.
rachel: important: reconciler updates must be idempotent and auditable. add flat audit fields: last_change_by, last_change_reason, last_change_ts. avoid arrays to keep storage cheap.
devin: also expose two rollout metrics: reconciliations_applied and billing_delta_percent. alert if reconciliations_applied spikes > 0.5%/hour.
oming: for debug ergonomics, add SDK helper obs.resolve_billing_for_span(span_id, prefer_final=false) to avoid client-side heavy joins. frontend can use prefer_final=true when user explicitly requests finalized numbers.
lee: storage impact: provenance + audit ~+18 bytes/envelope -> ~0.5% overall. finance OK. we should feature-flag the rollout (obs.billing_handoff_v1).
ops-bot: deploy-plan: reconciler-canary scheduled Mon 03:00 UTC behind feature flag :gear:
rachel: migration plan: backfill last 7 days as enriched provenance, canary 5% traffic 48h, then ramp. docs must clearly state "finalized within 24h by default".
devin: action items: (1) lee PR for schema fields and metrics (2) oming implement reconciler join logic + perf estimate (3) rachel write doc + API contract (4) ops run canary and backfill.
lee: quick pseudocode for reconciler decision: if envelope.provenance == "reconciled" skip; else if join_key != null and join_key != envelope.billing_key then update envelope and set provenance="reconciled" and record last_change_*. only update if joined_confidence >= threshold.
oming: agree. standardize confidence semantics: float in [0,1], enricher indicates confidence, reconciler accepts enriched overrides if confidence >= 0.9 or external join confirms.
rachel: fine, I'll post a short RFC addendum consolidating fields, thresholds, and rollout cadence. unless objections I'll land schema PR tomorrow.
devin: +1
lee: +1
ops-bot: reminder: infra sync Tue 10:00  add billing handoff rollout to agenda.
